title: Playboy Magazine October 1965 Madalyn Murray Interview Allison Parks Playmate
descriptionText:
Good condition. See pics.

The Playboy Magazine October 1965 issue features an interview with Madalyn Murray, known for her controversial stance on religion, as well as a spread featuring the Playmate of the Month, Allison Parks. The magazine is filled with articles and photo spreads focusing on women, art & photography, with a particular emphasis on photography and modeling. With its iconic illustrated covers and engaging content, this vintage issue from 1965 is a collector's item for fans of classic adult magazines.
